body:
Related to #4179? 

Even so, I recommend to post your question on [CodeIgniter forums](http://forum.codeigniter.com/), it's more likely you are having an issue with your own project, rather than a CodeIgniter issue.

There's a thousand things that can break sessions.
PHP 7.1 has a release candidate, but is not officially out yet.
PHP 7.0 runs just fine for other people using CodeIgniter's sessions.

How did you determine that this is a bug?

And also, you don't need to prefix your title with `[bug]` - we don't welcome non-bug threads here.

https://github.com/bcit-ci/CodeIgniter/issues/3649

In php 7.1 are new session configuration values:
session.sid_length
session.sid_bits_per_character
http://php.net/manual/en/session.configuration.php#ini.session.sid-length

and by default values regex: /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/ is not working.
... and that has nothing to do with 7.0.

I see the session_start() call database helper's read() function with new session_id every time.  I think it may because PHP not found session id information in cookie.

is there any changes to PHP 7.1 on cookie part?

issue.title: CI update needed for "improved" PHP 7.1 session variable

repository.name: Stikked
repository.description: An advanced and beautiful pastebin written in PHP

issue.body:
Basically this hits stikked too:
https://github.com/bcit-ci/CodeIgniter/issues/4830

In php 7.1 are new session configuration values:
session.sid_length
session.sid_bits_per_character
http://php.net/manual/en/session.configuration.php#ini.session.sid-length
and thus default values regex: /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/ are not working anymore.

This breaks Stikked e.g. on Fedora 26 which has (mod_)php 7.1.6.
E.g. the Captcha won't work anymore with the default php.ini values.

issue.body: I've been using php 7.0 for a while and everything works fine and still does (with sessions), but I noticed something when I upgraded to 7.1 for about a week, sessions were being created every page view instead, not sure if this is a php thing or a CI related issue. But 7.0 works great, upgrading to 7.1 caused all sessions to create a new session every page view, really bogged down one of my servers having over 1 million session files in the session directory. I downgraded to 7.0 and everything is working once again.
